1115-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4013-7185.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Belonging.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4377-7638-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mind Stone.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

765-774-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Guildless Commons's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
1887-7009-7334.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

565-1542-1858--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1542-1858--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

512-2691-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-2691-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-4210.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-4053-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1069-1232-5499-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-6968.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

224-1193-1846-1980-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1193-1846-1980-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Swarm Intelligence triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Swarm Intelligence ability.
Resolve the copy of Swarm Intelligence's ability, copying the Mythos of Illuna spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Mythos of Illuna, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

560-1545-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Trostani triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-1545-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2921-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
2921-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3767-3918-4452-4851.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4452-4851.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-4452-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4616-5147-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4616-5147-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

101-1809-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1809-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Returned Pastcaller.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1809-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1636-5256-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5256-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

224-423-2309-3143-5413.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2309-3143-5413.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land, giving it +0/+3 until end of turn.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

1039-3358-4314.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-3358-4314.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1512-1636-1774.notablePrerequisites: Sand Squid and Stonybrook Schoolmaster do not have summoning sickness.
1512-1636-1774.description:
Activate Sand Squid by tapping it, tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
When the Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2634-3593-5312.description:
Cast Explosive Welcome by paying {7}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Explosive Welcome.
Resolve the copy of Explosive Welcome, dealing 5 damage to any target, 3 damage to any other target and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

259-2104-4428.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1636-3654-4680.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3654-4680.description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

549-3764-5256.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Pincher, targeting any player.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing the targeted player to mill two cards.
Repeat.

224-2244.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {W}.
224-2244.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking the land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Ruin Ghost.
Repeat.

1127-4944.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit's ability.
Hold priority and repeat this an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Crackdown Construct triggers, making Crackdown Construct arbitrarily large.
